# Paths an agent may never merge on its own.
#
# ONE source of truth, read by two independent enforcers:
#
#   .github/workflows/healthcheck.yml   the `risk-gate` job — labels the PR
#   .claude/skills/queue/SKILL.md       the `/queue` loop — refuses to merge
#
# Both call scripts/risk-check.sh, so neither can drift from the other, and the
# loop does not have to trust a label it could have applied itself. A PR whose
# diff touches any pattern here is a human merge, whatever the issue said.
#
# Patterns are fnmatch against repository-relative paths, and `*` crosses `/`
# — `web/functions/*` covers `web/functions/downloads/[[file]].ts`. Blank lines
# and #-comments are ignored.

# ---- Code signing, entitlements, sandbox
# Getting one of these wrong doesn't fail the build; it ships an app that is
# denied a permission at runtime with no prompt and no error. Nothing in CI
# would notice, because CI ad-hoc signs.
*.entitlements
Synesthia-Direct-Info.plist
Synesthia/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy

# ---- Project configuration
# Nine copies of every build setting across two targets and three
# configurations, plus the synchronized-group rules that make hand-edits
# corrupt the project. See CLAUDE.md.
Synesthia.xcodeproj/*

# ---- Versioning and the release pipeline
# Releases are human-initiated and human-approved, always. An agent may change
# this tooling under review; it may never operate it.
VERSION
scripts/bump-version.sh
scripts/build-appstore.sh
scripts/build-direct.sh
scripts/make-appcast.sh
scripts/publish-release.sh
scripts/release-notes.py
scripts/release.env
scripts/sparkle-keys.sh
docs/releases/*

# ---- The Sparkle serving path
# A one-word whitelist here 404'd the delta for every copy of 1.2, and the only
# symptom was a line in each user's log. Reviewed by a person from now on.
web/functions/*
web/lib/releases.ts
web/wrangler.jsonc

# ---- The CPU/GPU contract
# VizUniforms and the MSL struct must stay byte-identical, and the option block
# must stay contiguous. Both sides assert it, but a plausible-looking edit that
# satisfies both asserts can still shift what a shader reads.
Synesthia/Visualizers/Shaders.metal
Synesthia/Visualizers/VisualizerCore.swift

# ---- The rules themselves
# An agent that can widen its own permissions has none.
.github/*
.claude/*
CLAUDE.md
Makefile
scripts/risk-check.sh
scripts/sync-labels.sh
